Revision Policy

Revision rounds 1 and 2 are included free. Revision round 3 onward is payable. Major scope changes or new requirements are quoted separately.

Important

Domain, hosting, premium plugins/themes, paid APIs, stock assets, payment gateway charges and shipping provider charges are separate unless explicitly included in the approved quotation.
